apps.name: TallyDex
apps.subtitle: Track Pokémon TCG sets and your collection.
apps.localizedDescription: A native, local-first iPhone app for browsing Pokémon TCG series and sets and building a personal collection.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds an exact Open on Cardmarket action to card details and repairs missing Normal, Reverse Holo, and Holo choices by combining TCGdex variant flags with its detailed marketplace printing data, including already-cached cards.

Fixes exact per-printing marketplace prices and card-detail tab-bar clearance, adds partial ownership progress rings, advanced Search filters and layouts, configurable default Custom collection rules, and a saved Cardmarket listing-country preference.

Adds exact per-printing Cardmarket EUR and TCGplayer USD prices supplied by TCGdex, configurable price-source settings, quantity-aware values for sets, custom folders, and the full collection, explicit unpriced-printing counts, an 18-hour price cache, and daily local price snapshots.

Loads and caches all TCGdex printing variants independently of each set goal, hides extra printings in Normal while revealing them instantly in Master, preserves richer cached variant data, adds a default collection-goal setting, and creates restorable backups before goal changes.

Adds pull-down search inside sets, simplifies collection goals to Normal, Master, and Custom, defaults ownership to a single checkmark with optional exact quantities, and adds Lucario Prerelease and Prerelease Staff printings.

Makes My Sets and Hidden functional, adds All/Owned/Missing set filters, Complete/Holo Chase/Custom goals with goal-aware progress, collection-folder search/filter/sort, and per-card wishlist and notes.

Adds persistent custom collection folders powered by card-name rules, All or Owned display modes, cross-set completion progress, source-set labels, quick ownership checkmarks, and long-press folder editing.

Adds persistent per-printing card quantities, quick checkmarks in set grids, Main and Master collection goals configured by long-pressing a set and choosing Edit, live cards-owned progress, and a populated Collection tab.
Preloads and caches the complete searchable card index, identifies each result by set and collector number, and supports combined searches such as Hidden Fates Metapod without opening the set first.

Automatically checks for catalog updates, adds cached card grids and detailed card views, enables local card search, fixes missing-artwork fallbacks, and protects original TallyDex work with a proprietary license.

Caches all catalog artwork for faster cold launches, adds selective cache controls and copyright attribution, uses the TallyDex mark for missing artwork, and enlarges series logos on the main Sets page.
Shows authentic expansion symbols for pre-Scarlet & Violet sets, includes announced upcoming sets, improves special-collection artwork fallbacks, and adds IPA distribution.
